Subject: Eval asset exchange — MAP, usage covenant, and close timeline

Hi Sarah / Acme team,

Thanks again for the productive sync yesterday. As discussed, attaching a short proposed MAP and a draft usage covenant to guide the exchange of evaluation materials (prompt pack, test cases, and a small seed dataset). Key asks from our side:

- Confirmation that the test cases will be provided in anonymized form (PII removed)
- Agreement on an ephemeral access window (we propose 30 days for sandbox ingestion/testing)
- Acceptance of the limited-use covenant (no external redistribution; retention <= 30 days unless otherwise agreed)

High-level milestones in the attached proposed_map.xlsx:
1) MAP Milestone 1 — prompt pack delivery + access token setup (sandbox)
2) MAP Milestone 2 — dataset ingest, checksum + lineage doc, QA run
3) MAP Milestone 3 — acceptance window and close/return or destruction

Proposed close timeline: kickoff next week, prompt pack available by 2027-04-05, dataset by 2027-04-12, acceptance/close by 2027-04-26. If Acme needs acceleration we can explore a partial prompt-only pilot earlier.

Please review the usage_covenant.md attachment and confirm whether Acme procurement needs any additional fields in the MAP for PO/contracting. If you prefer, loop in your procurement contact and I will introduce our finance lead.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships (onboarding)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_map.xlsx (spreadsheet), usage_covenant.md (text)

Hi Naomi,

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick items from our side:

- We can supply anonymized test cases; data team will run PII scrub and provide a manifest.
- Our security team requests that retention be capped at 30 days in your sandbox (we cannot approve long-term token retention).
- We will need SOC2 evidence and a short statement on key management for the sandbox environment (happy to accept a link or short doc).

Procurement: please cc procure@acme.ai on future contractual language. They typically require a short clause referencing data handling controls and destruction confirmation post-acceptance. Im attaching our security checklist for reference (acme_security_requirements.pdf).

Timeline: the dates you suggested look workable. Procurement aims to issue a PO by 2027-04-02 once the MAP and usage covenant match our internal checklist.

Hi Sarah — quick technical notes and a confirmation of our approach:

1) Sandbox access model: we will provide a time-limited API key tied to an ephemeral environment. Keys auto-expire at 30 days; we will also run a scheduled job to clear KV/prefix caches at handback.

2) Anonymization: once you share the manifest we will run ingestion validation (checksum + simple schema checks). We cannot re-identify any fields post-ingest — logs for audit will be redacted and retained for 90 days by default; we can redact token payloads if you require tighter controls.

3) Delivery cadence: prompt pack -> 2027-04-05 (as Naomi proposed). Small seed dataset (<= 5k lines) -> 2027-04-12. We will run the initial QA pass and share a test report within 3 business days of ingest.

If that aligns Ill add these specifics into the MAP spreadsheet and version it. Also adding a short acceptance checklist (ingest success, QA pass, no PII found).

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Sarah / Naomi — adding a few contractual/ops clarifications for the MAP so procurement has what they need:

- Ownership/licensing: materials remain Acme property; Redwood receives a limited, nonexclusive evaluation license scoped to the MAP milestones and specific environments listed in the usage_covenant.md.
- Accept/Reject gates: Acceptance requires (a) ingest + checksum match, (b) QA report showing no PII, (c) successful run of 3 canonical test cases from the prompt pack.
- Evidence: At close we will provide a signed destruction certificate (or confirmation of return) and the ingestion audit log (file-level checksums).

Linking the draft MAP in Drive here: https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/ACME-MAP-v1 — please confirm if procurement needs this embedded in the PO or if a short clause referencing the Drive doc is sufficient.

I will update the proposed_map.xlsx to include the acceptance checklist and the specific license language for evaluation-only use.
